name: Band Seated Curl
steps: Sit upright on a flat bench with both feet pinning the middle of a resistance band and grasp the ends with palms facing forward.
Tuck your elbows snugly against your sides and brace your core.
Curl both hands smoothly up toward your shoulders by flexing strictly at the elbows.
Lower both hands slowly back beside your thighs while maintaining light tension on the band.
tips: Keep your upper arms stationary at your sides as the band lengthens and shortens.
Avoid leaning backward to heave through peak tension at the top.
